Build a facetBars facet configuration

Source: R/bars_spec.R
facet_spec.Rd

Keys map 1:1 to gsm.viz spec.facet (field, order, nCol, chartHeight, label, scales, legend).

Usage

facet_spec(
  field,
  order = NULL,
  nCol = NULL,
  chartHeight = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  scales = NULL,
  legend = NULL
)

Arguments

field

character(1) Column to facet by. Required.

order, nCol, chartHeight, label, scales, legend

Passed through 1:1.

Value

A plain list for facet_bars().
